architectureDecisions: D1 — Keep usage's six keys for Codex/Kiro/agy and existing totalCostUsd for Grok/OpenCode. Add sibling usageAccounting to parser results and trace bodies. Keep V1 trace/report identifiers, digest algorithm and old bytes unchanged.

D2 — usageAccounting={version:'USAGE_ACCOUNTING_V1',state,reasons,fields}. All five fields (four tokens plus totalCostUsd) have {state:COMPLETE|PARTIAL|UNAVAILABLE,observedUnits,expectedUnits,observedTotal,total}. Units include EVERY Codex turn.completed/OpenCode step_finish, even invalid or absent usage; Grok is one response. Collect each field independently, including cost without tokens. Unsupported fields are UNAVAILABLE.

D3 — COMPLETE requires a nonempty known cohort, a valid value in every unit and no capture/lifecycle uncertainty; total=observedTotal. PARTIAL requires observations without full coverage; total=null. UNAVAILABLE has observedTotal=total=null. Zero counts as observed. expectedUnits=null for unknown cohort (truncation, invalid output, timeout, unfinished lifecycle), else all-unit count. Tokens/count sums are safe nonnegative integers; costs/sums finite nonnegative numbers; overflow publishes no sum and adds AGGREGATE_OVERFLOW.

D4 — Core state COMPLETE requires both input/output COMPLETE; otherwise PARTIAL if any field observed, else UNAVAILABLE. Optional states are independent. Each legacy usage[field] equals its complete field total, never observedTotal; independently complete fields survive a missing partner. uncertain streams have all legacy totals null. unavailableReason=null only for complete core. The existing experiment consumer thus receives conservative nullable fields without edits.

D5 — JSONL counts all completions before validation and retains event counts/invalidLines. Nonblank bad JSON, nonobject or missing-type lines add INVALID_OUTPUT. Truncation always applies, even after valid completions. Track starts/terminals in order: an open observed start or failed/error terminal adds INCOMPLETE_LIFECYCLE. Completion-only fixtures do not need starts. Missing required fields add MISSING_REQUIRED_USAGE; known-cohort complete fields remain independently complete.

D6 — Grok invalidJson (including outside-object text) or truncated flag prevents complete fields; balanced valid prefixes retain observed partial values; unparseable JSON has none. num_turns is never a usage denominator. Reuse BB-123's exact finite-number >=0 cost guard unchanged; no Number coercion or new cost contract. Preserve OpenCode's strict part.cost guard.

D7 — Timeout parses retained stdout for all three structured tools and retains partial observations only in metadata. TOOL_UNAVAILABLE, unknown, Kiro/agy keep existing null usage/source/reason and UNAVAILABLE metadata. Unique reasons use fixed priority: TIMED_OUT, tool-specific truncation, INVALID_OUTPUT, INCOMPLETE_LIFECYCLE, AGGREGATE_OVERFLOW, MISSING_REQUIRED_USAGE, existing not-reported/unsupported reason. Optional omissions use field states. No text/stderr inference.

D8 — Report fieldCoverage has all five fields; each={state,completeTraces,partialTraces,unavailableTraces,observedTotal,total}. Counts partition ALL group traces. COMPLETE needs every trace field complete in a nonempty group; PARTIAL has observations without full coverage; otherwise UNAVAILABLE. observedTotal includes partials, total only whole-cohort completeness. No core-token gate for cost. Validate metadata version/state/values/counts/totals; invalid metadata never grants completeness and records INVALID_ACCOUNTING_METADATA.

D9 — Keep coveredTraces as COMPLETE-core count and uncoveredTraces its complement; add core complete/partial/unavailable counts. Retain named totalsOverCoveredTraces and totalCostUsdOverCoveredTraces for that subset, but an optional total is null unless every covered trace has that field COMPLETE; empty subset all null. Only fieldCoverage.total represents all traces. Preserve reason counts, deterministic grouping and DESCRIPTIVE-only semantics.

D10 — Missing metadata means LEGACY_COMPLETENESS_UNKNOWN: valid legacy fields are PARTIAL observations, never complete from null reason/exit/excerpts/absent flags. Trace timeout/truncation/invalid-output flags only downgrade accounting. Old lines verify and append byte-identically; new metadata is digest-bound and tampering fails. No migration rewrite/version bump.

D11 — Focused subject-invoking fixtures pin exact counts/states/null/zero. Update stale existing parser tests only where behavior changes: BB-098 codex-usage.jsonl contains malformed records and now supplies partial observations. Preserve fixture bytes and valid Grok/OpenCode complete outputs. Exercise read-only usageObservationFromTraces with parsed incomplete streams.

D12 — Keep bounded capture; defer streaming. Actual child-process capture retained 10 of synthetic 40 input tokens with truncated=true; in-memory model kept observed 10 while withholding complete total. No real-provider/streaming benefit was measured. Prototype proves feasibility only; Worker invokes actual symbols.

D13 — Living docs describe metadata, independent denominators, observed partial sums, unknown legacy completeness and unchanged digest verification. No Blackboard ids/readiness claims. Only authorized files may change; preserve BB-123 cost validation and grounded-context behavior.
implementationSlices: S1 — output-parsers.js: implement D2-D7 unit/field completeness plus sibling metadata, preserve partial observations and zero, consume unchanged BB-123 guard. accounting-completeness.test.js U fixtures call parseToolOutput directly; update existing run-trace/Grok/OpenCode test expectations only where the newly truthful contract changes them.

S2 — report.js: implement D8-D10 fieldCoverage and conservative legacy normalization, keep deterministic grouping/subset fields; accounting-completeness.test.js R fixtures call summarizeTraces directly over mixed coverage and cost-only observations.

S3 — run-trace.js: copy parsed.usageAccounting in buildTraceBody before digesting, with unchanged chain algorithm and no old-file rewrite. accounting-completeness.test.js T fixtures build bodies, append a legacy line then a new line, verify byte-identical prefix, and reject metadata mutation. Exercise read-only usageObservationFromTraces with parsed partial traces.

S4 — Living observation/state documentation and scoped regression expectation updates under D11/D13; run all named criterion checks, package/consumer regressions and docs. Collect exact candidate-bound evidence for independent Worker Jev; do not self-issue READY or delivery.
